meta.title: Our Way Through the Aquarium
meta.textType: functional: a plan with a key, and a talk about it

paragraphs: On Thursday, November fifth, the Explorers met in the school library for the club hour. Teacher Kim gave each group a big plan of the aquarium. The plan showed all the rooms, the paths, and one small bridge. In the corner was a small box called the key. A fish means a tank, a cup means the cafe, and a bag means the shop. A little person means the toilets, and an arrow means the exit. "A plan shows you the way," said Teacher Kim. "The key explains the signs." Leo, Mia, Lily, and May stood around their table. Lily took a red pencil.

"We start at the entrance," said Mia. "Then we go through the shark tunnel." Lily drew a red line on the plan. "After the tunnel, turn left at the jellyfish room," said Leo. "Then go straight on, past the cafe," said May. "Cross the bridge, and follow the wide path," said Lily. "The outdoor seal pool is further than the cafe." "Where is the octopus?" asked Leo. "Next to the shark tunnel," said Mia. "Next to the tunnel?" asked Leo. "Yes, on the left side of the tunnel," said Mia, and she pointed at the plan.

May wrote the order of the places in her notebook. "First the entrance," she read, "then the shark tunnel and the jellyfish room." "Then the cafe, and last the seal pool." Teacher Kim stood at the end of the table with the other plans. "The shop is shut from twelve to one," she said. "Where will you eat lunch?" "At the cafe," said Leo, "because the shop is shut." "The cafe is against the wall of the jellyfish room," said Mia. "So it is easy to find."

"How long will the walk take?" asked Teacher Kim. "About one hour," said May. "But we will stop and look at the fish." "Good," said Teacher Kim. "Now, which way is the exit?" Lily looked at the arrow on the plan. "From the seal pool, turn right at the corner," she said. "Then walk past the shop to the exit."
Leo smiled and looked at the red line. "On Saturday, we will not get lost," he said. "We have a plan, and it is a good one." "I think so, too," said Teacher Kim. "Bring your plans on Saturday."

images.prompt: A large plan of an aquarium lies on a library table. The rooms are blue, green, and yellow and are labeled "ENTRANCE", "SHARK TUNNEL", "JELLYFISH ROOM", "OCTOPUS TANK", "OUTDOOR SEAL POOL", "CAFE", "SHOP", and "EXIT". A small bridge is drawn on a path. A key box in one corner says "KEY: fish = tank, cup = cafe, bag = shop, person = toilets, arrow = exit". Leo, Mia, Lily, and May stand around the table, and Lily holds a red pencil.
